title: Lena organises an exhibition (paraphrase)
topic: A museum guide named Lena prepares an exhibition of old portraits; the show opens on Saturday

target_note: Same target as formulation A: 'ticket' is the natural continuation of 'each visitor buys a' in the exhibition context where admission is charged; the word and its German equivalents (Eintrittskarte / Ticket / Karte) occur nowhere in the units or the tail. ' ticket' is a single Pythia token (id 13571); Pythia-160m ranks it first after the all-English context (p ~ 0.33).
author: LS-NEQ stimulus authoring (F01B, museum guide Lena, paraphrase)
notes: Formulation B: independent re-phrasing of the ten meaning units of F01A in both languages (same events, same order, same names Lena and Hamburg). Unit 2 refers to the director as 'her boss' / 'ihr Chef' and uses the reflexive 'sich entscheiden für' (non-separable); unit 3 'the gallery' / 'die Galerie' paraphrases 'the hall' as the exhibition room; unit 7 has the directional adjunct 'von der Decke aus' (the postposition 'aus' belongs to the adjunct, not to the verb). No separable verbs. Subjects vary between protagonist, other people (boss, helpers, conservator, reporter) and objects (painting, spotlights, show). Unit 9 reads naturally in German; units 1 and 10 read naturally in English.
